Shopify files no DEF 14A; its security ownership disclosure is Item 12 of the Form 10-K/A Amendment No. 1 (accession 0001594805-26-000011, filed April 29, 2026), which adds Part III only and does not restate the financial statements, as at April 21, 2026. LEADER: Tobias Lütke is CEO. The filing states class percentages (0.13% of Class A, 99.59% of Class B, the one Founder Share) and 40.02% of aggregate voting power, but no percentage of all shares, so pctEconomic is null and the 6.11% is in leader.derived. It counts shares owned, controlled or directed: 1,290,000 Class A and 66,130,362 Class B held by 7910240 Canada Inc. and 258,000 Class A held by Thistledown Foundation, which Lütke is deemed to own, plus 11,619,770 Class B held directly. The beneficial-ownership table, which also counts 786,822 Class A shares from options and RSUs (exercisable or vesting within 60 days), shows him with 2,334,822 Class A shares (less than 1% of Class A); on that SEC basis (option and RSU shares added to numerator and denominator) the derived figure would be 6.16% rather than 6.11%. HOLDERS: the filing says Lütke is the only person or entity known to own more than 5% of any class, so largestHolders is empty. CASH: no dividends have ever been paid; the FY2025 financing section shows only option-exercise proceeds and the $1,043 million maturity of convertible notes, and Item 5 reports no issuer purchases of equity securities, so buybacks are 0. The board authorized a repurchase program of up to $2 billion of Class A shares in February 2026, after the fiscal year. footprint.notes: Two editions, kept under separate metric keys so they are never mixed. The newest is Shopify's own 'The Entrepreneur Effect' (published October 2026; figures for the year ending June 30, 2026; tier company-published; no outside modeller named). It supplies all 50 state rows (no DC row; its 'Territories/Other' row, $5.5B and 19K, is not mapped) and a nine-market country table (Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, Spain, United Kingdom, United States), whose rows replace the Deloitte 2021 rows for those nine countries. The other eight countries (Mexico, China, Hong Kong, India, Singapore, Netherlands, Sweden, New Zealand) and the EU keep Deloitte's 'Global Economic Impact Study of Shopify, 2021 Refresh' (Shopify engaged Deloitte; tier company-commissioned), the PDF Shopify attaches to its April 28, 2022 newsroom release; no newer edition with figures for those countries was found (checked 2026-11-24). The EU region is a 2021 Deloitte aggregate: under its own metric it overlaps only the Netherlands and Sweden rows (France, Germany, Italy and Spain now sit under the 2026 metric), and it is not a sum of either. The two editions use different definitions (Deloitte's merchant-only business activity vs Shopify's ecosystem economic activity including partners), so their figures are not comparable. The May 2023 Shopify Entrepreneurship Index (2022 data) pages (shopify.com/media/index-beta) returned 404 in the earlier pass and are not used. Values printed as $…M (AK, ND, WV) are stored in billions (e.g. $583M = 0.583); jobs printed as '12K' or '2.3M' are stored as 12000 or 2300000. All figures are modelled gross impacts including indirect and induced effects. The cross-border growth column is not recorded. Shopify owns no real property (FY2025 10-K Item 2) and is remote-first, so sites are only its two principal executive office addresses from the FY2025 10-K cover (the original 10-K; the 10-K/A of April 2026 does not change them); the New York address moved to 85 10th Avenue.
